title: All replay arms parse sessions through one driver and arm C claims before SessionStart
body:
Astra audit E3/E4 (verified partly): arm A interprets its session through evals/replay/live.ts:142-151 (sessionOf) with a different "ran" rule than arm-session.ts:118-120 and session-result.ts:212-234 (budget cap counts as ran in B/C only if is_error is false in A); arm C (evals/replay/arm-c.ts:17-28) adopts KRN without claiming the task, and src/hook/session-standards.ts:24-25 serves nothing without a claim; arm B counts only the initial packet (arm-b.ts:42-45).
Files: evals/replay/live.ts, evals/replay/arm-session.ts, evals/replay/arm-c.ts, test/evals/arm-parity.test.ts
Outcome: all arms parse sessions through session-result.ts; arm C claims its task before the session so SessionStart serves standards; each row attests the injected token total; the parity test exits 0.
Proof: node --test test/evals/arm-parity.test.ts passes: one budget-capped fixture yields the same ran/graded status in A, B and C, and arm C's SessionStart serves a non-empty packet.
